comments.body:
Correct English name for this discovery: Diocletian's Palace

Quest name: Ruins of the Eastern Empire
Quest location: Venice Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r8 Recognition, r10 Archaeology, FRE(French)

comments.author: Fields
comments.body: The palace where Emperor Diocletian lived after he abdicated the throne. It was built in the port city of Split on the Adriatic Sea. It is surrounded by a strong wall with a height of more than 20 meters. It has the aspect of a military facility and the luxury of a palace.
